summary: Count rows, browse Ravelry collections, and read your synced patterns offline.
page_description: Count rows for each section of a project, browse your Ravelry library, and read patterns you own offline.
release_notes: Clearer description in the Store. No change to how the app works.

steps.text: Ravelry library sync requires an approved Ravelry API account and HTTP Basic credential.
Install the credential under the exact name ravelry.
Prepare and transfer a PDF you own with Poppler's pdftotext installed.
